title: A night in Can Gio
summary: Leave Ho Chi Minh City early for the Bình Khánh ferry, give the creek a half day at Vàm Sát, and eat at Hàng Dương after that gate closes. Sleep in the beach town. The whale temple is the next morning. The salt pans are a different dawn, and only in December–May.

days.title: Ferry, the creek, and Hàng Dương
days.body: Start early. Visit HCMC prints about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km; Tuổi Trẻ prints about 2 hours. The ferry itself is about 10–15 minutes, and a holiday queue on the approach can eat the morning. Vàm Sát is open 8:00–17:00. The wooden boat to Đầm Dơi is capped at two hours, which is the only minute count on that tariff. The Sac Forest gate on the tourism page is 7:30–17:30, a different desk. After 17:00 the evening is Hàng Dương. A 2019 story puts the sand about 50 m from the market, and one stall’s cook-to-order wait at about 30–40 minutes on a busy day. Sleep in xã Cần Giờ.

days.title: The shore, then the ferry back
days.body: The morning in town is the silt sand if you slept beside Hàng Dương. Lăng Ông is a short look on an ordinary morning. Hours and a ticket were not printed. Check on arrival. The salt morning is a different day, December–May, and it starts at dawn. Minutes to the pans were not printed. Then the same ferry back to Ho Chi Minh City. The September 2026 story still had the ferry as the crossing.

stops.name: Wooden boat to Đầm Dơi
stops.note: 120 minutes is the cap on the wooden boat to Đầm Dơi. The operator calls the road-gate visit a half day and does not print a minute count for the whole gate. Road gate 60,000 VND, shuttle included, 8:00–17:00 every day. Visit HCMC prints the canoe leg from 270,000 to 895,000 VND. The operator’s canoe table runs from 1,075,000 for one person to 270,000 from nineteen.

approach.note: Along đường Rừng Sác to cầu Dần Xây or the road gate. Minutes from the beach town were not printed. Check on arrival.

seoTitle: A night in Can Gio — ferry, creek, and Hàng Dương
seoDescription: Two days from Ho Chi Minh City: the Bình Khánh ferry, a half day at Vàm Sát, Hàng Dương after 17:00, and the whale temple the next morning. Sleep in town.
